meta_description: Review AI-generated code with evidence before you trust it.
footer_description: Review AI-generated code with evidence before you trust it.
landing_badge: Open-source code review for AI changes
landing_title: Review AI-generated code with evidence, not guesswork.
landing_lede: AI agents change code quickly. patchplane shows what changed, what ran, and what still needs human approval before you trust the result.
landing_problem_title: Agents move fast. Review still takes human judgment.
landing_problem_intro: A convincing diff is not enough. Developers need a clear record of what happened before they can trust an AI-generated change.
landing_problem_1_detail: The request, intended scope, and reason for the change can disappear between the agent and the pull request.
landing_problem_2_detail: Logs, test results, changed files, and review notes often live in separate tools.
landing_problem_3_detail: Reviewers are left to reconstruct whether a generated change is ready to trust.
landing_how_title: One clear path from AI change to human decision.
landing_how_intro: patchplane keeps the change, verification, evidence, and decision together in the GitHub review workflow.
landing_step_1_detail: Keep the request and code change connected.
landing_step_2_detail: Verify generated code away from trusted systems.
landing_step_3_detail: Bring checks, output, and artifacts into one review.
landing_step_4_detail: Leave the final call with a human reviewer.
landing_step_5_detail: Publish the result where the team already works.
landing_demo_summary_detail: The change, isolated run, captured artifacts, and final human decision stay together.
landing_demo_ready_detail: Automation has finished. Patchplane stops before the human decision.
landing_demo_alert_detail: A maintainer still owns the final decision.
landing_demo_captured_detail: Every result remains attached to the patch report.
landing_demo_logs_detail: Raw execution evidence stays available to the reviewer.
landing_demo_decision_detail: The report informs the reviewer; it never replaces them.
landing_alpha_title: Focused on one reliable GitHub review workflow.
landing_alpha_body: patchplane is being built in public. Explore what works today, try it locally, or follow development on the roadmap.
landing_final_title: Help make AI code review trustworthy.
landing_final_intro: Start patchplane locally or contribute to the open-source review workflow.
app_signed_out_workflows_intro: patchplane keeps workflow evidence, sandbox logs, and review state behind your workspace session.
app_workflow_prompt_placeholder: Describe the patch or review task patchplane should track.
app_workflow_start_signed_out: Sign in before starting a workflow.
app_workflow_start_no_org: Select an active WorkOS organization before starting a workflow.
app_workflow_start_success: Workflow started and recorded in Convex.
app_workflow_status_detail: Create a tracked review run with prompt, source, evidence, and trust state.
app_prompt_description: Describe the change and acceptance criteria. Pull-request workflows use the repository and ref supplied by GitHub.
app_github_connect_intro: Connect a repository to receive evidence-backed Patch Reports for pull requests.
app_github_requires_org: Select an active WorkOS organization before connecting GitHub.
app_github_empty: No repositories connected yet. Connect GitHub to start routing PR verification workflows.
app_loading_workflows_detail: Loading workflow queue and report status.
app_no_organization_detail: Select an organization in AuthKit so PatchPlane can scope repositories, workflows, and decisions safely.
app_queue_empty_detail: Start a workflow or clear the current search and status filter.
app_queue_caption: Workflow runs with source context, execution status, trust state, and update time.
app_detail_open_github: Open source event on GitHub (opens in a new tab)
app_changes_empty_detail: This workflow has not produced a reviewable change yet.
app_changes_captured: Candidate patch captured from the isolated sandbox.
app_changes_identity_detail: The exact patch projection evaluated by review and policy.
app_changes_unified_detail: Exact changed lines from the candidate’s referenced evidence artifact.
app_changes_partial_warning: Inspect the complete evidence artifact and record an explicit rationale before deciding. Do not treat this preview as the complete patch.
app_changes_use_retry: Use Retry diff to retry this exact artifact.
app_changes_stats_unavailable: Diff artifact unavailable; statistics cannot be calculated.
app_changes_stats_retrieval_failed: Diff retrieval failed; statistics are unavailable.
app_changes_stats_calculated: Calculated from the loaded durable diff.
app_changes_stats_binary: Statistics unavailable because the diff contains binary content.
app_changes_stats_empty: Statistics unavailable because the diff is empty.
app_changes_stats_malformed: Statistics unavailable because the diff is malformed or unsupported.
app_changes_stats_missing: Statistics unavailable because the artifact response did not include them.
app_changes_stats_oversized: Statistics unavailable because the diff exceeds the parsing limit.
app_changes_stats_truncated: Statistics unavailable because the diff preview is truncated.
app_changes_stats_load: Load the durable diff to calculate statistics.
app_diff_candidate_only: Candidate diff only—not the full repository.
app_diff_no_paths: No trustworthy candidate paths could be projected from this artifact.
app_diff_no_safe_path: No candidate path is presented as safe to navigate.
app_diff_not_complete: Do not treat this changed-file list as the complete patch.
app_diff_reason_record: malformed or unsupported record was excluded
app_diff_reason_records: malformed or unsupported records were excluded
app_diff_binary: Binary content has no trustworthy line-by-line preview.
app_diff_submodule: This record changes a submodule pointer rather than repository file text.
app_diff_metadata: This record contains metadata changes without a supported textual hunk.
app_diff_no_hunk: No textual hunk for this file
app_diff_inspect_artifact: Inspect the candidate-bound evidence artifact before making a decision.
app_diff_decorations: File decorations describe change and content status.
app_detail_rerun_versioned_only: Another run is available only for versioned workflow attempts.
app_detail_rerun_wait: Wait for this attempt to reach review or fail before requesting another run.
app_diagnostics_detail: PatchPlane-owned read-model data for debugging. Raw evidence remains in the linked artifacts.
app_diagnostics_caption: Normalized workflow diagnostic groups. Expand a row to inspect its PatchPlane-owned data.
app_table_empty_detail: PatchPlane will show captured evidence here when the runtime records it.
app_logs_intro: Compare captured records first, then expand only the raw evidence you need.
app_logs_runtime_caption: Normalized runtime events. Expand a row to inspect its full payload.
app_logs_stdout_caption: Sandbox standard output streams. Expand a row to inspect its captured output.
app_logs_stderr_caption: Sandbox standard error streams. Expand a row to inspect its captured output.
app_logs_truncated_detail: normalized events. Full raw output remains in the evidence artifact.
app_activity_intro: Durable intake, execution, review, decision, and publication history.
app_activity_truncated: Older sandbox execution previews are omitted; durable evidence remains available in artifacts.
app_activity_caption: Workflow activity in chronological order. Expand a row to inspect its details.
app_artifacts_intro: Evidence artifact references linked from runtime events.
app_artifacts_empty_detail: Runtime events and command logs are recorded. R2-backed artifact metadata appears here when available.
app_sandbox_intro: Daytona execution evidence for this workflow.
app_sandbox_empty_detail: This workflow has no sandbox execution yet, so it is not trusted.
app_runtime_intro: Pi/Daytona runtime session lifecycle for this workflow.
app_runtime_empty_detail: JSON-mode runs may only have runtime events. RPC-capable runs record active sessions here.
app_runtime_remote_intro: Remote runtime process state captured from Daytona sessions.
app_rerun_dispatch_attention: Child run created; dispatch needs attention.
app_rerun_intro: Creates a new immutable child attempt. This report and its evidence remain unchanged.
app_rerun_error_title: Another run could not be started
app_rerun_reason_placeholder: Explain what should change or why another attempt is needed.
app_rerun_reason_detail: The reason is recorded with the child workflow lineage.
app_rerun_child_ready: The new immutable attempt is ready.
app_review_intro: Maintainer-controlled dogfooding requires an explicit comment before any decision.
app_review_unavailable_detail: The latest execution, candidate, review, and policy records do not form one coherent projection. Refresh after verification completes.
app_review_rationale: Add the rationale that will be stored in the Patch Report.
app_review_override_placeholder: Explain why approval is justified despite incomplete or unconfigured verification.
app_review_override_detail: Required because verification is incomplete. This override is stored in the audit trail.
app_review_success_approved: Decision approved and queued for source-control publication.
app_review_success_rejected: Decision rejected and queued for source-control publication.
app_review_success_changes: Changes requested and queued for source-control publication.
app_trust_recorded_override: Recorded with an explicit verification override.
app_trust_records_truncated: Verification records are truncated. Approval is blocked until the complete projection is available.
app_trust_no_required: No required verification is configured; approval requires an explicit override.
app_trust_records_incomplete: Trust records are incomplete; decisions fail closed.
app_trust_decision_superseded: The previous human decision was superseded by newer evidence.
app_overview_requested_detail: Original request attached to this report.
app_overview_verdict_detail: Review and policy results before the human decision.
app_overview_no_verdict: Policy has not produced a verdict.
app_overview_human_required: Human approval is required before this candidate can be trusted.
app_overview_additional_findings: additional findings are retained in the report diagnostics.
app_overview_decision_publication_detail: Who decided, why, and what PatchPlane published afterward.
app_overview_previous_decision: A previous decision was superseded by newer evidence.
app_github_connection_failed_detail: Repository access could not be synchronized. Retry the connection or check the selected installation.
app_github_connected_detail: Selected repositories are now available to this workspace.
app_trust_policy_incomplete: Required verification records are incomplete; policy requires human review.
app_trust_policy_unconfigured: Required verification is not configured; policy requires human review.
app_trust_policy_passed: Required verification passed; human approval is still required.
app_trust_policy_checks: required checks passed; policy requires human review.
